headline: Bono, Eddie Vedder Honor Oscar-Winning Songwriter Glen Hansard at Dublin Funeral
deck: The music world mourns the loss of the acclaimed artist, tragically killed in a single-vehicle crash.
body: Oscar-winning songwriter Glen Hansard died early Wednesday in a single-vehicle crash in Dublin, with music icons Bono and Eddie Vedder performing at his funeral. The unexpected loss of the acclaimed artist drew a significant gathering of peers to pay their final respects in the Irish capital.

Both U2 frontman Bono and Pearl Jam's Eddie Vedder took to the stage during the Dublin service, honoring Hansard's legacy through song. Their performances underscored the deep respect Hansard commanded within the global music community.

Beyond their musical tributes, Bono and Vedder were among the many mourners present at the funeral. Their attendance highlighted the personal and professional connections Hansard forged throughout his career.

Hansard earned international acclaim as an Oscar-winning songwriter, a testament to his profound talent and distinctive voice. His contributions to music left an indelible mark on audiences and fellow artists alike.

Critics and fans consistently praised Hansard for crafting "beautiful music" that resonated deeply with listeners. His unique sound and poignant lyrics defined a significant portion of his artistic output.

Hansard's sudden passing leaves a void in the music landscape, prompting reflections on his lasting influence. The outpouring of tributes from his celebrated contemporaries affirms his enduring place among modern music's revered figures.
